Clinch night window: Midtown, Thu 10 Jun 2027

Armed. The Knicks lead the Finals 3–2, and Game 6, away and watched in the city, can clinch the title. (Schedule: TheSportsDB, checked against a published announcement.)

The window: from tip-off at 8:30 pm to about 4:05 am, in Midtown (the NYPD's Midtown South and Midtown North precincts). The busiest hour is expected to be the first after the final buzzer, estimated at 11:05 pm.

Why this night: On past clinch and title nights, Midtown saw a sharp rise in injury calls 2 of 6 times. On an ordinary night that happens about 3 times in 100. (Our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records, 2025–2026: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj.)

Before the night, as of Tuesday morning:
- Weather (NWS): a low near 70°F on Thursday night; no heat or storm alert.
- Other crowds (NYC permitted events): no parade or street event in precincts 14 or 18.
- Official advisories (local press, read by hand): no outdoor watch party announced.

This is a time to be ready, not a forecast that anything will happen. It is not an emergency service: anyone hurt or in danger, call 911.
